name: typegpu-inspector-language-server
description: Language server and CLI for TypeGPU inspection: hovers, inlay hints, diagnostics, generated WGSL, and a check command for shells and CI.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --define:__TYPEGPU_SERVER_VERSION__=$(node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').version)") --define:__TYPEGPU_INSPECTOR_VERSION__=$(node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').version)") --banner:js="const importMetaUrl = require('node:url').pathToFileURL(__filename).href;" --define:import.meta.url=importMetaUrl --outfile=dist/server.cjs
scripts.test:e2e: node test/lsp-smoke.cjs dist/server.cjs ../inspector/test/fixtures/symbol-targets.ts && node test/cli-smoke.cjs dist/server.cjs
